title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
title_zh: 4DCodeBench：动态场景逆图形学中的智能体基准测试

paragraphs.en: We introduce 4DCodeBench , a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 4DCodeBench，这是一个通过代码生成来评估 4D 逆图形能力的基准测试，其中智能体将视频中的动态场景重构为可执行的图形程序。 为实现这一目标，智能体必须将视觉观察结果转化为场景结构和动态的紧凑表示，并通过实现物理模拟等抽象概念来重现复杂行为。 为了评估这种能力，我们整理了一系列真实世界的视频，并构建了涵盖多种物理现象的合成场景，包括形变、流体流动和断裂。 我们对前沿模型进行了广泛的基准测试，发现强大的静态重建能力尚未能转化为对复杂动态的可靠重建。4DCodeBench 提供了一个测试平台，用于追踪智能体通过代码解读世界动态能力的进展。 我们的基准测试可在 github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench 获取。

paragraphs.en: Inverse graphics is often approached by fitting a prescribed model to visual observations. Recovering an executable graphics program instead moves model specification into the inference problem. The program specifies what geometry to construct and how to represent it.
paragraphs.zh: 逆图形学通常通过将预定模型拟合到视觉观察结果来解决。 而恢复一个可执行的图形程序，则会将模型规格纳入推理问题中。 该程序会指定要构建的几何结构以及其表示方式。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic scenes render these modeling choices more consequential. Flow, fracture, and deformation involve changes in shape and often topology, while material interactions affect each other’s motion. Representing such phenomena extends beyond the placement of objects or recovery from a moving camera in a static scene. We ask how well multimodal coding agents can understand the dynamics of interacting objects and materials from video, choosing and implementing their own abstractions to reconstruct the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 动态场景使这些建模选择的影响更加显著。 流动、断裂和变形涉及形状乃至拓扑结构的变化，而材料相互作用则会影响彼此的运动。 要表现这类现象，需要超越在静态场景中放置物体或恢复移动摄像机视角的范畴。 我们想知道多模态编码智能体能否从视频中理解相互作用的物体与材料的动态变化，并选择、实施自己的抽象模型来重建场景。

paragraphs.en: We introduce 4DCodeBench to evaluate this capability through 4D inverse graphics. Agents are given a reference video and tasked with writing code that generates the 3D geometry of the scene over time, and renders the result. We leave implementation of these dynamics open rather than requiring the use of a particular approach. This freedom renders the agents’ choices themselves part of the investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 4DCodeBench，通过 4D 逆向图形来评估这一能力。 智能体被给定一个参考视频，并需要编写代码以随时间生成场景的 3D 几何结构，然后渲染结果。 我们没有强制要求使用特定的方法，而是将这些动态的实现留作开放。 这种自由度使得智能体自身的选择也成为研究的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark includes 100 real-world videos and 100 synthetic scenes that span diverse materials and interactions. We separately evaluate appearance, geometry, and dynamics of the scene, comparing against reference videos and 3D ground truth on synthetic scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试包含 100 个真实世界视频和 100 个合成场景，涵盖了多种多样的材质和交互。 我们分别对场景的外观、几何结构和动态进行评估，并将其与参考视频以及合成场景中的 3D 真实数据进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Through evaluation of 18 frontier models, we observe that reconstruction of dynamics consistently lags behind that of appearance and static geometry. While analytic motion is the most-common strategy, we find that leading models differ substantially in their approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对 18 个前沿模型进行评估，我们发现动态的重建始终滞后于外观和静态几何形状的重建。 虽然解析运动是最常见的策略，但我们发现领先模型在方法上存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark and dataset for 4D inverse graphics through code generation. We introduce 4DCodeBench , comprising 200 dynamic scenes – 100 real videos and 100 synthetic scenes with 4D ground truth – spanning diverse materials, interactions, and physical phenomena. Agents must reconstruct each video as an executable graphics program that exposes explicit geometry and dynamics over time.
paragraphs.zh: 一个用于通过代码生成实现 4D 逆向图形学的基准和数据集。 我们提出了 4DCodeBench，它包含 200 个动态场景——100 个真实视频和 100 个带有 4D 真值的人工合成场景——涵盖了多样的材料、交互和物理现象。 智能体必须将每个视频重构为一个可执行的图形程序，该程序需显式地呈现随时间变化的几何结构和动态过程。

paragraphs.en: A comprehensive evaluation of frontier and open-weight models. We benchmark 18 multimodal coding models under a common execution environment and evaluation protocol, measuring visual fidelity, 2.5D and 3D geometry, and dynamics. Our analysis identifies substantial differences across models and shows that reconstructing dynamics remains a consistent weakness even when appearance and static geometry are recovered well.
paragraphs.zh: 对前沿模型和开放权重模型的综合评估。 我们在统一的执行环境和评估协议下，对 18 种多模态编码模型进行了基准测试，测量了视觉保真度、2.5D 和 3D 几何结构以及动态变化。 我们的分析揭示了不同模型之间的显著差异，并表明即使外观和静态几何结构能够被良好重建，动态变化的重建仍然是一个持续存在的弱点。

paragraphs.en: Human-aligned evaluation and analysis of reconstruction failures. We conduct a large-scale human preference study and develop automated VLM- and reconstruction-based metrics that closely track human judgments. Using these measurements, we analyze which scene properties and physical regimes expose different reconstruction failures, providing a diagnostic view of current model capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 与人类对齐的重建失败评估与分析。 我们开展了一项大规模的人类偏好研究，并开发了基于 VLM 和重建的自动化指标，这些指标能够紧密追踪人类的判断。 利用这些测量结果，我们分析了哪些场景属性和物理机制会导致不同的重建失败，从而为当前模型的能力提供了诊断性视角。

paragraphs.en: 4DCodeBench comprises 200 scenes: 100 real-world videos curated from existing datasets and the web and 100 synthetic scenes built with physics simulations. The two sources serve complementary roles. Real-world videos capture realistic appearance and complex dynamics without the simplifying physical assumptions of a simulator, but lack 4D ground truth. Synthetic scenes depend on these assumptions but provide ground-truth geometry and motion at every frame, enabling direct evaluation in 3D and 4D space, rather than solely comparing rendered frames in image space. Below we describe the task definition (§ 2.1 ), benchmark construction (§ 2.2 ), data statistics (§ 2.3 ), and evaluation metrics (§ 2.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 4DCodeBench 包含 200 个场景：100 个从现有数据集和网络中精选的真实世界视频，以及 100 个通过物理模拟构建的合成场景。 这两种来源发挥着互补的作用。 真实世界视频能够捕捉逼真的外观和复杂的动态变化，而无需像模拟器那样进行简化的物理假设，但缺乏 4D 基准数据。 合成场景依赖于这些假设，但能在每一帧提供基准几何结构和运动信息，从而能够在 3D 和 4D 空间中直接进行评估，而不仅仅是比较图像空间中的渲染帧。 下文我们将描述任务定义（§ 2.1）、基准构建（§ 2.2）、数据统计（§ 2.3）以及评估指标（§ 2.4）。

paragraphs.en: To construct the benchmark, we collect real-world videos and generate synthetic scenes covering a wide range of physical dynamics. These include scenes of robotic manipulation, controlled physics demonstrations, and everyday activities. We organize scenes into four primary categories: rigid and articulated bodies, deformable solids, co-dimensional structures such as cloth and rope, and flowing materials such as grains and fluids. Across these categories, scenes exhibit phenomena including collisions, deformation, flow, and fracture. We further characterize scenes by object count, material composition, and dynamics regime, distinguishing passive dynamics from externally driven motion, such as robotic manipulation or prescribed motion of rigid objects.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建该基准测试，我们收集了真实世界的视频，并生成了涵盖广泛物理动态的合成场景。 这些场景包括机器人操作、受控的物理演示以及日常活动。 我们将场景分为四大类：刚体和铰接体、可变形固体、共维结构（如布料和绳索），以及流动材料（如谷物和流体）。 在这些类别中，场景呈现出碰撞、形变、流动和断裂等现象。 我们还通过物体数量、材料组成和动态模式对场景进行进一步描述，区分被动动态与外部驱动的运动，例如机器人操作或刚体的预定运动。

paragraphs.en: Real-world scenes. We curate videos from existing physical-understanding, video-generation, and robotics datasets, supplemented with web-sourced footage. We select clips with diverse physical behaviors while minimizing repeated scenarios, prioritizing stationary cameras, limited occlusion, and continuous footage without cuts or editing-induced discontinuities. We also exclude humans and animals and minimize visible hands, since reconstructing their detailed geometry and articulation introduces challenges beyond our focus on dynamics. Each clip is manually selected and reviewed for visual quality and temporal continuity. Appendix C.2 lists the video sources and the number of scenes from each source.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界场景。 我们从现有的物理理解、视频生成和机器人学数据集中整理视频，并辅以网络来源的影像素材。 我们在选择片段时注重多样化的物理行为，同时尽量减少重复的场景，优先采用固定摄像头拍摄、遮挡有限且连续无剪辑或编辑导致的断裂的影像。 我们还排除人类和动物，并尽量减少可见的手部，因为重建它们的详细几何结构和关节活动会引入超出我们动力学研究重点的挑战。 每个片段都经过人工挑选，并检查其视觉质量和时间连续性。 附录 C.2 列出了视频来源以及各来源的场景数量。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic scenes. We construct synthetic scenes using existing physical simulators, extending their implementations where needed to support additional material models. Scenes are designed by the authors, combining procedurally generated geometry with publicly available meshes such as the Stanford bunny and armadillo. We select simulators suited to each scene’s desired materials and interactions and use them to compute the objects’ geometry and motion over time. We design diverse scenarios that vary geometry, material types and parameters, initial conditions, and rendering settings to create varied reconstruction tasks. Authors with experience in physical simulation developed and reviewed each scene for numerical instability, unintended interpenetration, and other visible simulation artifacts. Appendix C.3 and Table A3 list the simulators used and provides a breakdown of scenes by simulator.
paragraphs.zh: 合成场景。 我们使用现有的物理模拟器构建合成场景，并在必要时扩展其实现以支持额外的材料模型。 场景由作者设计，将程序生成的几何体与斯坦福兔和犰狳等公开可用的网格相结合。 我们为每个场景选择适合其所需材料和相互作用的模拟器，并利用它们计算物体随时间的几何形状和运动。 我们设计了多样化的场景，通过改变几何体、材料类型和参数、初始条件以及渲染设置，来创建多样的重建任务。 在物理模拟方面具有经验的作者们开发并审查了每个场景，以检测数值不稳定性、非预期的穿插以及其他可见的模拟伪影。 附录 C.3 和表 A3 列出了所使用的模拟器，并按模拟器对场景进行了分类说明。

paragraphs.en: Scene ontology. We organize scenes hierarchically by the matter of their main dynamic objects. We distinguish four broad classes: rigid and articulated , including rigid bodies and articulated systems; deformable solids , including hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic materials; co-dimensional structures, including shells and rods; and flowing materials, including granular media, Newtonian fluids, and viscoplastic fluids. Scenes may contain multiple matter types interacting with each other. The full breakdown is visualized in Appendix C .

We also distinguish passive dynamics, where motion follows from the initial state and subsequent physical interactions, from externally driven dynamics, such as robotic manipulation or prescribed motion of an object. paragraphs.en: A faithful 4D reconstruction must reproduce both the visual appearance and the physical dynamics of the observed scene. Because ground-truth availability is asymmetric – synthetic scenes provide full 4D world states while real videos provide only monocular views – our evaluation spans five metric families: Perceptual , 2D Dynamics , and 2.5D Geometry measured against the reference video, alongside 3D Geometry and 3D Dynamics evaluated against the reference world. The Overall score averages these five families; failed runs receive the worst score on the affected metrics (Appendix D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个忠实的 4D 重建必须同时再现所观察场景的视觉外观和物理动态。 由于真实基准数据的可用性是不对称的——合成场景提供了完整的 4D 世界状态，而真实视频仅提供单视角画面——我们的评估涵盖了五类指标：通过与参考视频对比得出的感知指标、2D 动态指标和 2.5D 几何指标，以及与参考世界对比得出的 3D 几何和 3D 动态指标。 总体得分是这五类指标的平均值；运行失败的案例将在受影响的指标上获得最低分数（附录 D.1）。

paragraphs.en: Video-reference evaluations. On all scenes, Perceptual measures visual and semantic fidelity to the reference video using DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) similarity, and 2D Dynamics measures the coverage of moving objects ( Dynamic IoU ). On real videos, we additionally estimate optical flow, point trajectories, and depth from the reference video with off-the-shelf vision models; 2D Dynamics compares the flow ( Flow ) and trajectories ( Track2D ), and 2.5D Geometry compares the depth ( Depth error ). On the reconstruction side, these quantities are computed analytically from the 4D world rather than estimated from rendered pixels (Appendices D.2 and D.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 视频参考评估。 在所有场景中，感知度量使用 DINOv3（Siméoni 等人，2025）相似性衡量视觉和语义对参考视频的保真度，而 2D Dynamics 则衡量移动物体的覆盖范围（动态 IoU）。 在真实视频中，我们还利用现成的视觉模型从参考视频中估计光流、点轨迹和深度；2D Dynamics 比较光流（Flow）和轨迹（Track2D），而 2.5D Geometry 则比较深度（深度误差）。 在重建方面，这些量值是从 4D 世界中通过解析计算得出的，而不是从渲染后的像素中估计的（附录 D.2 和 D.3）。

paragraphs.en: vlm-based VQA and pairwise evaluation. We further evaluate reconstructions with a \tl_set:Ne vlm as a judge. VQA asks scene-specific questions in four categories: initial state, final state, key events, and contact; questions are gated by the presence of the scene’s main object (Figure 5 ; Appendix D.5 ). Pairwise evaluation presents the reference video together with two reconstructions and asks which more closely matches the reference in geometry and dynamics. Pairwise preferences are aggregated across scenes into a model-level Elo rating using a Bradley–Terry model (Appendix D.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于 VLM 的 VQA 和成对评估。 我们进一步使用一个 \tl_set:Nevlm 作为评判者来评估重建结果。 VQA 针对场景提出四类具体问题：初始状态、最终状态、关键事件和接触；这些问题以场景中主要对象是否存在为条件（图 5；附录 D.5）。 成对评估将参考视频与两个重建结果一同呈现，并询问哪一个在几何结构和动态方面更贴近参考。 成对偏好被跨场景汇总，通过 Bradley–Terry 模型计算得出模型级别的 Elo 评分（附录 D.6）。

sents.en: VQA asks scene-specific questions in four categories: initial state, final state, key events, and contact; questions are gated by the presence of the scene’s main object (Figure 5 ; Appendix D.5 ).

sents.en: Pairwise evaluation presents the reference video together with two reconstructions and asks which more closely matches the reference in geometry and dynamics.

sents.en: Pairwise preferences are aggregated across scenes into a model-level Elo rating using a Bradley–Terry model (Appendix D.6 ).

paragraphs.en: 4D-reference evaluations. On synthetic scenes, after aligning the reconstruction to the reference (Appendix D.4 ), 3D Geometry measures static surface accuracy at frame 0 via Chamfer distance ( Scene 3D ). 3D Dynamics compares motion from two complementary views: a Lagrangian perspective tracking matter along persistent 3D paths ( Trajectory DTW ), and an Eulerian perspective comparing frame-to-frame displacement distributions without correspondence ( EMD step ).
paragraphs.zh: 4D参考评估。 在合成场景中，将重建结果与参考对齐后（附录 D.4），3D几何通过切姆弗距离（场景3D）衡量第0帧的静态表面准确性。3D动力学则从两种互补视角比较运动：拉格朗日视角沿持续的3D路径追踪物质（轨迹DTW），以及欧拉视角比较帧与帧之间的位移分布而不考虑对应关系（EMD步骤）。

paragraphs.en: Each agent must return an executable program together with a reconstructed scene containing the rendered video, camera parameters, per-frame geometry, and temporal correspondence for dynamic matter. The program must regenerate the reconstruction from scratch without accessing the reference video. We describe the exact file structure, coordinate conventions, and validation requirements in Appendix G.3 . Note that we do not restrict how dynamics are implemented; for example, animation and physical simulation are two possible approaches. Dynamics may be implemented in Blender, using simulation libraries such as Taichi ( Hu et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2020 ; Hu et al., 2021 ) or Warp ( Macklin, 2022 ) , or with custom code. The program must also expose its geometric state in each evaluated frame, allowing evaluation of both rendered appearance and, for synthetic scenes, geometry and motion against 4D ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都必须返回一个可执行的程序，以及一个重构后的场景，其中包含渲染的视频、相机参数、每帧的几何信息以及动态物体的时间对应关系。 该程序必须从头开始重新生成重构结果，而不能访问参考视频。 我们在附录 G.3 中详细描述了确切的文件结构、坐标约定和验证要求。 请注意，我们并未限制动态效果的实现方式；例如，动画和物理模拟是两种可能的实现方法。 动态效果可以在 Blender 中实现，使用 Taichi（Hu et al., 2019; Hu et al., 2020; Hu et al., 2021）或 Warp（Macklin, 2022）等模拟库，也可以使用自定义代码实现。 该程序还必须在每个评估帧中暴露其几何状态，以便能够同时评估渲染外观，以及对于合成场景，还能评估几何形状和运动与 4D 基准数据的匹配程度。

paragraphs.en: We run a pairwise human preference study on all 200 scenes to measure perceived reconstruction quality and to validate the automated metrics. Each trial shows the reference video, then the renders of two models side by side in random order; participants pick the one closer to the reference in geometry, layout, and dynamics, or mark them about the same (10.5% of responses). Model pairs are sampled adaptively to shrink the widest confidence intervals ( Chiang et al., 2024 ) , and judgments are aggregated into Elo ratings with a Bradley–Terry model ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) as for the \tl_set:Ne vlm judge. The study covers 17 of the 18 models (all but Opus 5.5 [High]). We collect 3,587 judgments from 76 participants; 209 comparisons are judged by several participants and 916 also by the \tl_set:Ne vlm, which lets us measure inter-rater and human– \tl_set:Ne vlm agreement (Section 4.1 ; Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对全部 200 个场景进行了成对的人类偏好研究，以衡量感知到的重建质量并验证自动化指标。 每次试验会先展示参考视频，然后以随机顺序并排显示两个模型的渲染结果；参与者需选择几何结构、布局和动态效果更接近参考视频的一个模型，或标记两者大致相同（占 10.5% 的回应）。 模型对通过自适应采样进行选取，以缩小最宽的置信区间（Chiang et al., 2024），并通过 Bradley–Terry 模型（Bradley & Terry, 1952）将判断结果汇总为 Elo 评分，与 \tl_set:Ne vlm 评判器的方法一致。 该研究涵盖了 18 个模型中的 17 个（除 Opus 5.5 [High] 外）。 我们从 76 名参与者处收集了 3,587 条判断；其中 209 组对比由多名参与者共同评判，另有 916 组对比也由 \tl_set:Ne vlm 进行了评判，这使我们能够衡量评判者之间以及人类与 \tl_set:Ne vlm 的一致性（第 4.1 节；附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Human judgments support this ranking. Across 3,587 pairwise judgments from 76 participants, human and VLM Elo correlate very strongly across models (Spearman ρ = 0.980 \rho=0.980 ; Figure 2 ). We additionally measure agreement on the shared set of individual comparisons. On 916 shared comparisons, human and VLM judgments agree in 89.3% of cases ( κ = 0.761 \kappa=0.761 ), near the 92.1% agreement between human annotators on repeated comparisons ( κ = 0.816 \kappa=0.816 ). Human Elo also correlates with the Overall score ( ρ = 0.96 \rho=0.96 ). paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating coding agents on spatial and physical tasks, from constructing 3D objects to implementing simple simulations. 3DCodeBench tests whether agents can model 3D objects in code from text or images ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . PhysCodeBench tests whether they can write executable physics simulations from text descriptions ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基准测试已开始评估编码智能体在空间与物理任务上的表现，从构建三维物体到实现简单的模拟。3DCodeBench 测试了智能体能否根据文本或图像用代码对三维物体进行建模（Gao et al., 2026）。 PhysCodeBench 测试了它们能否根据文本描述编写可执行的物理模拟程序（Xie et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: VisPhyWorld instead gives agents synthetic physics videos to reconstruct as simulator code ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . MPMWorlds also reconstructs synthetic videos, covering deformation, material changes, and topology-changing events in 2D ( Kovačič & Ellis, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our current evaluation focuses on reconstruction fidelity, leaving the underlying physical mechanisms underconstrained. Prescribed trajectories can achieve high scores, while the generalization benefits of simulation remain largely untested. Interventions on initial conditions and external forces, together with longer-horizon prediction, would be a good way to assess transferable physical understanding in future work. Our evaluation also focuses on final submissions; tracking intermediate reconstructions across render-and-compare rounds would reveal how quality improves with iteration and token expenditure, when gains saturate, and how effectively agents use visual feedback.

paragraphs.en: Discussion. 4DCodeBench highlights several directions for improving agents that reconstruct dynamic scenes through graphics code. The persistent gap between static and dynamic reconstruction underscores the challenge of inferring material properties, interactions, and driving forces from video and translating them into accurate physics solvers. Leading models adopt markedly different reconstruction strategies, ranging from predominantly analytic motion to custom physical simulations. This raises the question of when simulation improves reconstruction quality and whether requiring physics-based simulation would preserve the relative performance of these models. Meanwhile, greater token expenditure across models does not consistently yield better reconstructions, highlighting the importance of reasoning efficiency. Stronger physical intuition could help agents form plausible hypotheses earlier, anticipate the consequences of modeling choices, and use targeted feedback to refine their solutions with fewer render-and-compare iterations.

paragraphs.en: Humans reason about physical scenes by mentally simulating them with an approximate internal physics engine, grounded in core knowledge of objects and mechanics ( Spelke & Kinzler, 2007 ; Battaglia et al., 2013 ; Ullman et al., 2017 ) . Early computational frameworks such as Galileo and visual de-animation operationalize this principle by inferring structured, object-centric states from video and simulating them to predict and explain observed dynamics ( Wu et al., 2015 ; Wu et al., 2017a ) . Most contemporary benchmarks, however, probe physical reasoning through indirect surrogate tasks rather than explicit state representations, relying on outcome prediction and plausibility judgments ( Tung et al., 2023 ; Bordes et al., 2025 ) , question answering ( Chow et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , or the physical plausibility of generated videos ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Motamed et al., 2026 ) . Formulating scene understanding as world-program generation revives this explicit state representation, requiring agents to commit their physical understanding to an executable 4D scene that can be simulated, inspected, and verified.
paragraphs.zh: 人类通过用近似的内部物理引擎在脑海中模拟物理场景来进行推理，而这一引擎的基础是对物体和力学核心知识的理解（Spelke & Kinzler, 2007；Battaglia et al., 2013；Ullman et al., 2017）。 早期的计算框架，如 Galileo 和视觉去动画化方法，通过从视频中推断出结构化的、以物体为中心的状态并对其进行模拟来预测和解释观察到的动态过程，从而实现了这一原则（Wu et al., 2015；Wu et al., 2017a）。 然而，大多数当代基准测试并非通过明确的状态表示，而是借助间接的代理任务来检验物理推理能力，这些任务依赖于结果预测和合理性判断（Tung et al., 2023；Bordes et al., 2025）、问答任务（Chow et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026），或生成视频的物理合理性（Bansal et al., 2025；Motamed et al., 2026）。 将场景理解表述为世界程序生成，重新引入了这种明确的状态表示方式，要求智能体将其物理理解转化为一个可执行的四维场景，从而能够被模拟、检查和验证。

paragraphs.en: Inverse graphics frames visual perception as inverting the forward rendering process through analysis-by-synthesis ( Kersten et al., 2004 ; Yuille & Kersten, 2006 ) . Classical visual program induction pioneered this philosophy by recovering scenes as programs ( Kulkarni et al., 2015 ; Wu et al., 2017b ; Ritchie et al., 2023 ) , but was largely constrained to hand-crafted domain-specific languages. Recent LLM-powered coding agents lift this limitation, parsing static objects and indoor layouts from imagery into general-purpose graphics code ( Kulits et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Extending such programs to dynamic scenes introduces a fundamentally more demanding inverse problem: the program must capture not only spatial geometry, but also how the physical scene evolves over time. Forward simulation from text ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) avoids this inverse challenge, as generated code needs only to satisfy an open-ended description rather than match a specific physical observation. Video-conditioned benchmarks directly tackle this inverse problem, yet each focuses on a restricted regime (Table A1 ): VisPhyWorld and MPMWorlds operate on controlled synthetic simulations, with the latter confined to 2D ( Liang et al., 2026 ; Kovačič & Ellis, 2026 ) ; Δ \Delta ynamics and SceneActBench target primarily rigid and articulated systems ( Kao et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; and BVB reconstructs static indoor scenes under moving camera trajectories ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . Concurrently, Code as Worlds builds executable scenes from real footage, but its video pipeline fits object trajectories kinematically rather than inferring the underlying physics ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . By contrast, 4DCodeBench establishes a unified inverse-graphics benchmark across diverse real-world footage, spanning rigid, deformable, co-dimensional, and flowing matter, while evaluating the reconstructed 3D geometry and motion directly against ground truth on synthetic scenes.

paragraphs.en: We use several simulation methods to cover the range of materials and interactions represented in the synthetic subset. At a high level, Incremental Potential Contact (IPC) formulates contact using barrier potentials to robustly prevent intersections during deformable simulation ( Li et al., 2020 ) , while Affine Body Dynamics (ABD) extends related ideas to stiff and near-rigid bodies ( Lan et al., 2022 ) . Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) represents fluids using Lagrangian particles and is used for liquid dynamics, including fluid–rigid interactions and surface-tension effects. The Material Point Method (MPM) combines Lagrangian material points with an Eulerian background grid and supports a broad range of constitutive behaviors, including elasticity, plasticity, fracture, and coupled solid–fluid dynamics. We use several MPM variants specialized for different numerical and material regimes. Finally, the PPF Contact Solver uses finite-element models together with barrier-based contact handling for contact-rich simulations of shells, rods, and solids ( Ando, 2024 ) . More than two-thirds of the synthetic examples are generated using a simulator that is more advanced and richer than Blender.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用多种模拟方法，以覆盖合成子集中所表示的材料和相互作用范围。 从宏观层面来看，增量势接触（Incremental Potential Contact, IPC）利用势垒来构建接触模型，从而在可变形体模拟中有效防止物体相交（Li et al., 2020），而仿射体动力学（Affine Body Dynamics, ABD）则将相关思想扩展到刚性和近刚性物体（Lan et al., 2022）。 平滑粒子流体动力学（Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics, SPH）使用拉格朗日粒子来表示流体，并用于模拟液体动力学，包括流体与刚性体的相互作用以及表面张力效应。 材料点方法（Material Point Method, MPM）将拉格朗日材料点与欧拉背景网格相结合，能够支持多种本构行为，包括弹性、塑性、断裂以及固液耦合动力学。 我们使用了多种针对不同数值和材料特性专门优化的MPM变体。 最后，PPF接触求解器结合有限元模型与基于势垒的接触处理机制，用于模拟包含大量接触的壳、杆和固体结构（Ando, 2024）。 超过三分之二的合成示例是使用比Blender更先进且功能更丰富的模拟器生成的。

paragraphs.en: To ensure benchmark scores reflect both reconstruction fidelity and practical execution reliability, we first evaluate the validity of each submission. A submission is designated as executable if (i) its rendered video successfully decodes and matches the reference in resolution, frame count, and frame rate, and (ii) its 4D world passes structural format validation. Submissions producing an invalid video automatically fail all metrics; those producing a valid video but an invalid 4D world fail only geometry-dependent metrics. When a metric fails due to non-executability, it receives its worst possible value – 0 0 for bounded similarities and 2 2 for normalized depth error (matching their bounds in Sections D.2 and D.3 ) – so that aggregate scores penalize unexecutable outputs. When the reference scene itself lacks the prerequisite signal for a specific metric (e.g., it contains no trackable dynamic motion), that scene is excluded from the corresponding metric across all models. Surface rasterization fails to capture background details in six real scenes featuring transparent main objects. Consequently, these scenes are excluded from metrics comparing rasterized geometry to the reference video: Dynamic IoU, Depth error, Flow, Track2D, and Uni3D MoGe. Figure A7 shows the executability of each model: 90.1% of all submissions are executable, with at least 96.5% for every proprietary model and 29.0–95.5% for open-weight models.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保基准分数既能反映重建保真度，又能体现实际执行可靠性，我们首先评估每个提交结果的合法性。 若满足以下两个条件，则提交结果被视为可执行：(i) 其渲染的视频成功解码，并且在分辨率、帧数和帧率上与参考视频一致；(ii) 其 4D 世界通过结构格式验证。 生成无效视频的提交结果将自动在所有指标中失败；生成有效视频但 4D 世界无效的提交结果则仅在依赖几何结构的指标中失败。 当某个指标因无法执行而失败时，它将获得最差可能值——对于有界相似性指标为 0 0，对于归一化深度误差指标为 2 2（与 D.2 和 D.3 节中的边界一致）——从而使得综合分数对不可执行的输出进行惩罚。 当参考场景本身缺乏特定指标所需的前提信号时（例如，其中不包含可追踪的动态运动），该场景将在所有模型中从对应指标中排除。 在六个包含透明主物体的真实场景中，表面光栅化未能捕捉到背景细节。 因此，这些场景被排除在将光栅化几何结构与参考视频进行比较的指标之外：动态 IoU、深度误差、光流、Track2D 和 Uni3D MoGe。 图 A7 展示了每个模型的可执行性：所有提交结果中有 90.1% 是可执行的，其中每个专有模型的可执行率至少为 96.5%，开源权重模型的可执行率为 29.0–95.5%。

paragraphs.en: Each scene carries hand-written binary questions in four categories: initial state and final state (what is present and where, in the first and last frames), key events (what happens in between, and in what order), and contact (what the materials do where they touch). Over the 200 scenes there are 1,251 questions: 371 initial state, 354 final state, 308 key events, and 218 contact. A VLM judge ( Gemini 3.8 Flash ) sees 16 frames of the reconstruction – including the first and last frames – and answers all of a scene’s questions in one call, without the reference video.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景都包含四类手写二进制问题：初始状态和最终状态（第一帧和最后一帧中有哪些内容以及它们的位置）、关键事件（中间发生了什么以及发生的顺序），以及接触（材料在接触点处的相互作用）。 在这 200 个场景中，共有 1,251 个问题：371 个初始状态问题、354 个最终状态问题、308 个关键事件问题和 218 个接触问题。 一个 VLM 判题器（Gemini 3.8 Flash）会查看重建后的 16 帧画面——包括第一帧和最后一帧——并在一次调用中回答该场景的所有问题，而无需参考视频。

paragraphs.en: Two checks run before the VLM is asked to answer the questions. The first catches renders with nothing in them: a render fails if it has almost no edges, or if almost every pixel is the same color. These are blank, black, or flat-lit outputs. The second check is per scene. Every scene carries a presence question about its main object, and if the reconstruction fails it, the object is not in the video and the remaining answers say nothing about physics. The question essentially asks if the reconstruction contains anything that could even remotely try to represent the main dynamic object of the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 在要求 VLM 回答问题之前，会先运行两项检查。 第一项检查会渲染出空无一物的画面：如果渲染结果几乎没有任何边缘，或者几乎所有像素的颜色都相同，那么该渲染就会失败。 这些结果表现为空白、全黑或光照均匀的画面。 第二项检查则针对每个场景单独进行。 每个场景都包含一个关于其主要物体的存在性问题；如果重建失败，则该物体不会出现在视频中，而其余的答案也不会提及任何物理特性。 这个问题实际上是在询问：重建结果中是否有任何内容能够哪怕只是勉强地表现出场景中那个主要的动态物体。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a side-by-side user study to measure which reconstruction people judge closer to the reference. In each trial, participants view the reference video alongside rendered outputs from two randomly ordered models and, after replaying and scrubbing, select the one that matches the reference more closely in geometry, layout, and motion ( left , right , or about the same ). A session contains 49 comparisons on distinct scenes, balanced between real and synthetic splits, plus a practice trial and one comparison repeated with the sides swapped to evaluate self-consistency; participants give the same answer on 95.5% of the 67 repeated comparisons. paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项并排用户研究，以衡量人们认为哪种重建结果更接近参考视频。 在每次试验中，参与者会同时观看参考视频和两个随机排序模型渲染出的输出；经过重播和快进操作后，他们需要选择与参考视频在几何结构、布局和运动方面更为匹配的结果（左侧、右侧或大致相同）。 一个实验会话包含对 49 个不同场景的比较，这些场景在真实与合成数据之间保持平衡；此外还有一次练习试验，以及一次通过交换两侧结果进行重复比较以评估自一致性的试验；在 67 次重复比较中，参与者的答案有 95.5% 保持一致。 图 A12 展示了操作说明和界面。

paragraphs.en: Figure A21 compares each model on the 100 real and 100 synthetic scenes. Most models reconstruct real scenes worse, scoring lower on both VQA and Perceptual, and the drop is largest in the middle of the ranking (Gemini 3.8 Flash [High], DeepSeek v4.1 Flash [High], and Qwen3.8 Flash [XHigh]). The strongest models, however, differ sharply in real-world generalization. GPT-6 Astra [Max] instead carries its performance over to real scenes and widens its Elo lead there, showing the strongest real-world generalization among all models. Agents also do not spend more effort on the harder footage, as models use 17% fewer tokens on real scenes on average.

paragraphs.en: Table A4 shows a breakdown of how the models attempted to solve the 4DCodeBench tasks. Blender physics means the scene is carried by Blender’s own solvers, mostly point-cache bakes, the rigid-body world (105) and the cloth modifier (41), with Mantaflow used three times; custom simulations are written in the solution itself, 318 of them identifying an established method (MPM or MLS-MPM 111, PBD or XPBD 136, DEM 24, PBF 21, mass-spring 15, FEM 14, APIC 10, Verlet 9, FLIP 8) and the others integrating an unnamed scheme, which we detect from explicit time stepping (247), GPU kernels (43), neighbor queries for contact (41), impulse exchange between bodies (14) or particle-grid transfers (8); 155 run on Taichi and 102 on Warp. Analytic solutions instead evaluate a closed-form function of time. Examples include interpolating splines through chosen poses (539), a prescribed map that displaces every vertex (312), ballistic formulas with gravity written in (256), placement along a curve by arc length (236), hand-written pose tables (135) and piles rebuilt each frame to keep their volume, as a height field or a cone at a fixed slope (107).

paragraphs.en: To evaluate each model with its intended harness, we run proprietary models in their provider’s native command-line agent: Codex CLI for GPT models, Claude Code for Claude models, and the Antigravity CLI for Gemini. Each agent maintains its native system prompt and receives the task prompt (Appendix G.2 ) as its initial instruction.

paragraphs.en: Each run executes in a fresh, isolated container mounting the reference video ( /input/reference.mp4 ) and task context ( /task ) read-only, alongside an empty writable workspace ( /workspace ). The task directory provides the task prompt, world format specification ( world-format.md ), and render settings ( render-settings.md ). To prevent benchmark hacking and information leakage, all scene-specific metadata (e.g., scene names, descriptions, and reference 3D worlds) are stripped; operational parameters such as duration, resolution, and frame rate must be extracted directly from the video. Upon completion, only world/ and solution/ are collected for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都在一个全新的隔离容器中执行，该容器以只读方式挂载参考视频（/input/reference.mp4）和任务上下文（/task），同时提供一个空的可写工作区（/workspace）。 任务目录包含任务提示、世界格式规范（world-format.md）以及渲染设置（render-settings.md）。 为防止基准测试作弊和信息泄露，所有场景特定的元数据（例如场景名称、描述和参考 3D 世界）均被移除；持续时间、分辨率和帧率等运行参数必须直接从视频中提取。 运行结束后，仅收集 world/ 和 solution/ 目录用于评估。

paragraphs.en: To enable automated, unified evaluation directly from the true 4D state rather than relying solely on 2D video appearance, we require models to submit explicit 4D assets beyond the rendered video. Specifically, each submission must provide an executable build.sh inside solution/ that deterministically regenerates the explicit world/ representation, ensuring full reproducibility. Crucially, this export specification is designed to be lightweight, typically requiring only about 100 lines of standard Python export code. In practice, format compliance poses little barrier for most models: among runs that pass the initial video gate, only 5.4% fail subsequent 4D world validation ( ≤ 2.5 % \leq 2.5\% across proprietary models and 3.5–7.5% across open-weight models). The one exception is Gemma-4 31B (Figure A7 ). For all other models, benchmark failures thus stem from 4D reasoning and simulation limits rather than formatting friction.
paragraphs.zh: 为了能够直接从真实的 4D 状态进行自动化、统一的评估，而不是仅仅依赖 2D 视频外观，我们需要模型提交超出渲染视频范围的明确 4D 资产。 具体来说，每次提交都必须在 solution/ 目录下提供一个可执行的 build.sh 脚本，该脚本能够确定性地重新生成明确的世界/表示，从而确保完全的可重复性。 至关重要的是，这一导出规范被设计为轻量级，通常只需要大约 100 行标准的 Python 导出代码。 实际上，对于大多数模型而言，格式合规性几乎不构成障碍：在通过初始视频筛选的运行中，仅有 5.4% 的模型未能通过后续的 4D 世界验证（专有模型中 ≤ 2.5%，开源权重模型中为 3.5–7.5%）。 唯一的例外是 Gemma-4 31B（图 A7）。 对于所有其他模型，基准测试的失败因此源于 4D 推理和模拟能力的限制，而非格式问题。

paragraphs.en: A submission consists of two directories: solution/ contains the standalone program ( build.sh and accompanying scripts) that deterministically regenerates the reconstruction without network access or external assets, while world/ stores the output artifacts:

paragraphs.en: world/ camera.json {"intrinsics": K, "extrinsic": E} render.mp4 the rendered video meshes/<id>.npz vertices_TTTT (V_t,3) float32, faces_TTTT (T_t,3) int32 dynamics/<name>.npz pos (F,N,3) float32, ids (M,) uint16; faces (T,3) or tets (K,4) int32 solver/ the solver’s bake, for an identity-less liquid only All positions are in world-space meters ( + z +z up), and all frame-indexed data strictly align with the F F frames of render.mp4 .

paragraphs.en: camera.json defines a fixed pinhole camera shared across frames: a 3 × 3 3\times 3 intrinsic matrix K K (principal point at image center) and a 4 × 4 4\times 4 camera-to-world extrinsic transform E E ( + x +x right, + y +y down, + z +z forward).

paragraphs.en: To help agents catch low-level formatting or syntax errors during development and avoid accidental execution failures, we provide a public offline checker ( python -m checker ). At scoring time, the video gate enforces valid decoding and resolution and frame-rate parity, while the world gate verifies the presence and structural integrity of camera.json , meshes/ , dynamics/ , and build.sh .
paragraphs.zh: 为了帮助智能体在开发过程中发现低层级的格式或语法错误，并避免意外执行失败，我们提供了一个公共的离线检查工具（python -m checker）。 在评分阶段，视频关卡会强制执行有效的解码、分辨率和帧率一致性，而世界关卡则会验证 camera.json、meshes/、dynamics/ 和 build.sh 是否存在且结构完整。

paragraphs.en: To quantify the computational and economic footprint of agentic 4D reconstruction, Figure A22 reports per-task execution statistics across all 3,600 runs, totaling 5,983 hours and $16,495 in compute (open-weight models priced at OpenRouter rates). Since each agent step re-sends its context during multiple render-and-compare rounds, 97% of all tokens are cache reads (Table A5 ). Cache write counts all uncached input, and output includes reasoning. For open-weight models, the cache hit rate depends on the serving setup, so we assume perfect prefix caching and a 95% cache hit rate when computing cost. Per task, open-weight models expend a mean of 247 agent steps and 39.6M tokens compared to 101 steps and 11.8M tokens for proprietary models, yet cost less (mean $2.01 vs. $6.65) due to lower token pricing.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化智能体驱动的四维重建在计算和经济方面的影响，图 A22 报告了全部 3,600 次运行中每项任务的执行统计数据，总计耗时 5,983 小时，计算成本为 16,495 美元（开源模型按 OpenRouter 的费率定价）。 由于每个智能体步骤在多次渲染与比较循环中都会重新发送其上下文，因此所有令牌中有 97% 是缓存读取（表 A5）。 缓存写入统计了所有未缓存的输入，而输出则包含推理过程。 对于开源模型，缓存命中率取决于服务配置，因此在计算成本时，我们假设前缀缓存完美且缓存命中率为 95%。 在每项任务中，与专有模型所需的 101 个智能体步骤和 1,180 万个令牌相比，开源模型平均需要 247 个智能体步骤和 3,960 万个令牌，但由于令牌定价更低，其成本反而更少（平均为 2.01 美元，而专有模型为 6.65 美元）。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, sheer agent loop activity does not inherently yield better 4D reconstructions across models: while per-task cost correlates moderately with the Overall score (Spearman ρ = 0.65 \rho=0.65 ), raw step counts and token volume exhibit negligible correlation ( | ρ | ≤ 0.10 |\rho|\leq 0.10 ). For example, Qwen [XHigh] expends an extreme mean of 752 steps and 1.5M output tokens, yet ranks eleventh among 18 models. Conversely, holding model architecture fixed, increasing test-time reasoning scales performance monotonically: raising GPT-6 Astra from [Low] to [High] to [Max] increases output tokens (13K → \rightarrow 29K → \rightarrow 67K) and cost ($3.5 at [Low] to $11.3 at [Max]), steadily improving its Overall score from 0.726 to 0.791.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，单纯增加智能体循环活动本身并不会必然带来跨模型更优的4D重建效果：尽管每项任务的成本与总体评分存在中度相关性（Spearman ρ = 0.65 \rho=0.65），但原始步骤数和令牌量之间的相关性却微乎其微（|\rho| ≤ 0.10 |\rho|\leq 0.10）。 例如，Qwen [XHigh] 平均需要消耗高达752个步骤和150万个输出令牌，但在18个模型中仅排在第十一位。 相反，在保持模型架构不变的情况下，增加推理阶段的计算资源会单调提升性能：将GPT-6 Astra从[Low]提升至[High]再到[Max]，其输出令牌数（13K → \rightarrow 29K → \rightarrow 67K）和成本（[Low]时3.5美元至[Max]时11.3美元）均持续增加，同时总体评分也稳步从0.726提升至0.791。
